origins.section: The Header Says What the Solver Received
A Failed Run's Objective Line Means Nothing
GLOP and PDLP Logs Carry the Same Facts in Other Words

gates.says: all 3 of this quiz's answerable readings held and each was taken over the question as it stands

recorded.prompt:q-header: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-header: "Check the first line against the model before reading further ... A count that does not match what you meant to build is a bug found before any solving, such as a loop that added each row twice."
recorded.prompt:q-failed: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-failed: "There is no plan, so there is no objective; the line is printed anyway." ... "The rule for logs is the rule for results (lesson 1.1.3): read the status first. Only `Optimal` makes the objective line an answer."
recorded.prompt:q-pdlp: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-pdlp: "The gap can be negative, so it is its size that has to be small. PDLP ... stops at the first check where all three are below its tolerance"

recorded.prompt:q-header:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-header:a: The header describes "the model it was handed", before presolve, and presolve removes rows rather than adding them: "`rows 10(-39)` reads '10 rows left, 39 removed'".
recorded.prompt:q-header:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-header:b: Rows and nonzeros are separate counts: "49 rows are the 10 cash rows and 39 must rows ... The 706 **nonzeros** are the entries of the constraint matrix that are not zero".
recorded.prompt:q-header:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-header:c: "Scaling changes numbers, never the model's size: the row and column counts stay 10 and 368."
recorded.prompt:q-failed:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-failed:b: "There is no plan, so there is no objective; the line is printed anyway. A script that reads the objective line without the status line reports a plan worth $0."
recorded.prompt:q-failed:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-failed:c: "Presolve found the contradiction before any iteration, so there is no iteration line". Also: "Only `Optimal` makes the objective line an answer."
recorded.prompt:q-failed:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-failed:d: "**Objective value** is in the model's own sense, so positive again". "The sign flips back in the footer."
recorded.prompt:q-pdlp:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-pdlp:a: "The gap can be negative, so it is its size that has to be small." |−3.5e-03| is above 1e-06.
recorded.prompt:q-pdlp:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-pdlp:b: "stops at the first check where all three are below its tolerance"
recorded.prompt:q-pdlp:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-pdlp:d: "`prim_resid` is not zero at the end (0.0048 in the last table row)" on a run that ended "TERMINATION_REASON_OPTIMAL". The test is the relative residual against the tolerance, not zero.
